owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).details: Unreachable through the proxy (the core answers this selector); inert if called directly.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

queueSlash(address).details: M-5: withdraw() is blocked until the slash executes or is cancelled. CC-13: the BLS      path may not re-arm during its cooldown. Idempotent.

setAPNTSPrice(uint256).details: P0-11: absolute MIN/MAX and a ±10% per-update delta (skipped when the old price is 0).      Independent of the break-glass ±20% band of `emergencySetPrice` (different storage).

setGlobalPaused(bool).details: GOV-2 B.6 ②. While set, validatePaymasterUserOp returns SIG_FAILURE for every op before         parsing it; postOp, releaseStaleSponsorship and the token-side stale release keep         working, so ops already in flight settle or are released normally.

setOperatorPaused(address,bool).details: GOV-2 B.6 ①: NOT a plain `onlyOwnerOrGuardian` bool setter — the guardian passing         `false` reverts, so unpausing always goes through the owner (the timelock).

transferOwnership(address).details: `onlyOwner` is written out explicitly: an override does NOT inherit modifiers.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.details: Unreachable through the proxy (the core answers this selector); inert if called directly.

APNTS_TOKEN_TIMELOCK().notice: Window between queueing a `setAPNTsToken` change and being allowed to execute it.

acceptOwnership().notice: Complete a transfer started by `transferOwnership`; callable only by the nominee.

cancelAPNTsTokenChange().notice: Abort a queued APNTS_TOKEN swap before it executes.

cancelSlash(address).notice: Cancel a previously queued slash (owner only). Idempotent.

configureOperator(address,address).notice: Registers msg.sender as an operator with the given xPNTs token (must be the token the         wired factory issued for msg.sender, and a balance-mode v2 token).

emergencyActivatedAt().notice: Timestamp at which EMERGENCY mode was first activated; cleared on Chainlink recovery.

emergencyPendingPrice().notice: Pending emergency price (8 decimals, same scale as Chainlink).

emergencyQueuedAt().notice: Timestamp at which `emergencySetPrice` was last called; 0 if none queued.

emergencySetPrice(int256).notice: Queue an emergency price update. Only honored when Chainlink is stale and the new         price stays within ±20% of the last cached price; executable after EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK.

entryPoint().notice: The EntryPoint contract (immutable for gas savings on hot path)

executeAPNTsTokenChange().notice: Apply a previously queued APNTS_TOKEN swap. Owner only; requires the timelock to         have elapsed AND every operator balance drained (totalTrackedBalance ==         protocolRevenue <= PROTOCOL_REVENUE_BUFFER).

executeEmergencyPrice().notice: Apply a previously queued emergency price. Permissionless after the timelock, but         the stale-oracle, expiry and deviation gates are re-checked against execution-time state.

executeGasParams().notice: Owner-only. NOT relied upon for mid-bundle safety: an owner such as a         TimelockController with an open executor role can be driven from inside a user op.         Safety comes from the OpCtx snapshot (settleGasBound, cPostop, cWrap).

executeSlashWithBLS(address,uint8,bytes).notice: Execute slash triggered by BLS consensus (DVT Module only)

gasParams().notice: Effective parameters (defaults when never set) and the pending proposal.

getAvailableCredit(address,address).notice: Remaining credit headroom for `user` on `token` (saturating; spec §10.4 / R4-H4).

guardian().notice: May ONLY pause (an operator, or all sponsorship). Unpausing is owner-only.

isSlashPending(address).notice: Whether `operator` currently has a slash queued (withdraw-blocking flag set).

paused().notice: Global sponsorship stop: validatePaymasterUserOp returns SIG_FAILURE for every op,         checked before anything in the op is parsed. postOp / release are unaffected.

pendingAPNTsToken().notice: Pending APNTS_TOKEN swap; address(0) when none queued.

pendingAPNTsTokenEta().notice: Earliest timestamp at which `executeAPNTsTokenChange` may run.

pendingOwner().notice: The nominated owner; address(0) when there is no pending transfer.

priceValidUntil().notice: Returns the timestamp after which the cached price is considered stale (0 if never set).

primeBlsSlashCooldown().notice: One-shot prime of the global BLS-slash cooldown floor to `now + SLASH_BLS_COOLDOWN`.

queueGasParams(uint32,uint32,uint32,uint.notice: Queue new gas parameters; effective after GP_TIMELOCK via `executeGasParams`.

queueSlash(address).notice: Mark an operator as having a pending slash (owner or BLS aggregator only).

setAPNTSPrice(uint256).notice: Set the APNTS Price in USD (Owner Only)

setAPNTsToken(address).notice: Queue a new APNTS_TOKEN (effective after APNTS_TOKEN_TIMELOCK via executeAPNTsTokenChange).         Re-queueing refreshes the timer.

setAgentRegistries(address,address).notice: Set ERC-8004 agent registries (Owner only). The identity registry is called from         validation (`isRegisteredAgent`) and MUST be ERC-7562 compliant. address(0) disables.

setGlobalPaused(bool).notice: Stop (true) or resume (false) ALL sponsorship. Owner: both. Guardian: stop only.

setGuardian(address).notice: Set (or clear, with address(0)) the emergency guardian. Owner only.

setOperatorPaused(address,bool).notice: Pause / unpause an operator. Owner: both directions. Guardian: pause only.

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: Set the protocol fee basis points (Owner Only; hard cap MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE)

setTreasury(address).notice: Set the protocol treasury address (Owner Only)

slashOperator(address,uint8,uint256,stri.notice: Slash an operator (Admin/Governance only). Requires queueSlash first; 24h cooldown.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Start (or replace, or with address(0) cancel) a two-step ownership transfer.

updateBlockedStatus(address,address[],bo.notice: Batch update blocked status for users (Called by Registry via DVT)

updatePrice().notice: Update price cache from Chainlink oracle (keeper-callable).

updatePriceDVT(int256,uint256,bytes,uint.notice: Update price via DVT/BLS consensus (Chainlink fallback)

updateSBTStatus(address,bool).notice: Update SBT holder status (Called by Registry)
